patterns.label: CAPL
patterns.explain: CAPL: a closed accented syllable prefers a long vowel.

patterns.label: OPRL
patterns.explain: OPRL: an open pretonic syllable requires a long vowel.

patterns.label: CURS
patterns.explain: CURS: a closed unaccented syllable requires a short vowel.

patterns.label: OAPS
patterns.explain: OAPS: an open accented syllable prefers a short vowel.

patterns.label: OOPPS
patterns.explain: OOPPS: an originally open propretonic syllable gets a sheva.

patterns.label: Other
patterns.explain: This syllable does not show one of the five patterns, so it is an exception to them or follows a different pattern.

passages.title: Genesis 1:13
passages.note: Evening and morning, the third day.

passages.title: Genesis 2:1
passages.note: The heavens and the earth were finished.
